title: Fix the Missing Header
description: The program should print a greeting message using printf.
expectedBehavior: The program should compile cleanly and print 'Hello, World!'.
actualProblem: printf() is declared in stdio.h, which is never included. Most compilers will at least warn about an implicit declaration of printf, and on stricter/modern compilers this is a hard error.
explanation: Standard library functions like printf() must have their declarations pulled in via the appropriate header — #include <stdio.h> for printf, scanf, and other standard I/O functions — before they can be used.
